description: Random modifiers applied to each dungeon run. One modifier per run.

modifiers.name: Burning Ground
modifiers.description: The ground smolders. All combatants take 2% fire damage per turn.

modifiers.name: Cursed
modifiers.description: Healing abilities are 50% less effective. Potions work normally.

modifiers.name: Berserk
modifiers.description: Everyone deals +30% damage and takes +30% damage.

modifiers.name: Fortified
modifiers.description: All enemies have +25% DEF. Loot quality improved.

modifiers.name: Vampiric
modifiers.description: All attacks heal the attacker for 10% of damage dealt.

modifiers.name: Toxic Fumes
modifiers.description: Poison damage increased by 50%. Poison resist reduced by 10%.

modifiers.name: The Gauntlet
modifiers.description: No rest points between waves. +75% XP and gold.

modifiers.name: Calm Before Storm
modifiers.description: Party starts with +15% all stats. Boss is 20% stronger.

modifiers.name: Thorny
modifiers.description: All combatants reflect 5% of damage taken back to attackers.
